title: Restore GIS 2D React Renderer Tiles
description: GIS 2D shows no tiles (neither raster image nor vector). MapSession.uploadTile and uploadVectorTile throw "null pointer passed to rust" from wasm-bindgen in framework/renderer/react/components/gis-map-host.tsx. Bring the react renderer back to premigration level (git tag `premigration`, where gis/2d/react/index.tsx rendered tiles correctly) on the migrated architecture.
summary: GIS 2D react renderer showed no tiles: every backbone sync re-ran GisMapHost's mount layout-effect because dispatchCamera (via onCommand, which changes identity on each os-shell state update) was in the effect deps. Each re-run freed the wasm MapSession while tile fetches were in flight (wasm-bindgen "null pointer passed to rust" in uploadTile/uploadVectorTile) and tore down the boot before a frame rendered. Fixed by routing camera dispatch through a ref (premigration pattern) so the mount effect only depends on stable values, and added disposed guards around tile uploads so a genuine unmount mid-fetch can no longer call into a freed session. Also regenerated the stale plugin registry (it had been overwritten by a procedural playground session, leaving the gis plugin unregistered and the app failing with "No plugins loaded"). Verified at runtime on the gis 2d playground: vector and raster tiles fetch and upload without errors, world map renders with positions/routes/labels, zoom triggers clean tile refreshes.
